brief_summary: This study compares the impact of Xuezhikang and atorvastatin on glucose metabolism to explore the incidence of prediabetes patients developing diabetes after 24 weeks of Xuezhikang use, and by investigating the effect of Xuezhikang on blood glucose fluctuations, discusses the possible mechanisms by which Xuezhikang affects glucose metabolism.
brief_title: The Effects of Xuezhikang and Atorvastatin on Lipid in Patients With Dyslipidemia and Prediabetes
official_title: A Randomized Controlled Study on the Effects of Xuezhikang and Atorvastatin on Blood Glucose and Lipid Levels in Patients With Dyslipidemia and Prediabetes
